comparison.objective: Gauge seven blocks in the required GO/NO-GO sequence and sort them by tolerance; candidate tunes and secures a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated part pickup, gauge alignment, contact-based fit classification, and sorting versus small-tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking torque, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Every block must receive valid gauge checks and reach the correct tray, with strong penalties for escapes; candidate requires two safe repeatable impact stops within published energy, velocity, and stroke limits plus lock retention.
comparison.reason: The gauge task tests inspection-driven classification across multiple parts; the candidate tests closed-loop adjustment of one dynamic component. Shared contact sensing and alignment are generic only. Candidate numeric drift/rebound/overload criteria are still missing.
